title: euphrasia stricta subsp. edouardii
intro: Euphrasia stricta subsp. edouardii, commonly known as Edouard's eyebright, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Orobanchaceae. Edouard's eyebright is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of eye and respiratory issues, such as conjunctivitis and bronchitis. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing, making it a popular remedy in traditional herbal medicine. The bioactive constituents of Edouard's eyebright include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
